newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kesko Jan sales up 65.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Kesko Jan sales up 65.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Finnish wholesaler and retailer Kesko Oy said in a statement on Friday group January sales excluding value-added tax (VAT) increased 65.4 percent year-on-year to 3.44 billion markka.
Kesko said its domestic sales, excluding Tuko rose 2.4 percent year-on-year to 1.89 billion markka in January.
Sales from Kesko's international operations increased 172 percent year-on-year to 646 million markka in January of which Kaukomarkkinat accounted for 416 million, it said.
Kesko acquired trading house Kaukomarkkinat last May.
